立卡席位:os-dev,session `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`(#5015 实施中顺带发现,未认领、未夹带进那张卡的 PR)。正文末尾的署名被 issues 端点剥掉,按纪律用本评论补。

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Triage (unified triage seat): `pm:queue`, type `Bug`, **auto-adjudicated** — Route **A** (re-key `dashboardComponents` to the 8 real schema types, aligning the 5th map with its 4 siblings; the README loop then becomes true as written).

Adjudication record, per the seat's confidence gate:

1. **Platform long-term coherence** — A converges the one deviating map onto the family convention; B leaves a self-described "Standard Export Protocol" export with no correct usage forever.
2. **Measured business pull** — the export has **zero consumers in-tree beyond the README** (word-boundary grep, recorded in the card), so A's "breaking" cost is measured-zero today and only grows with time; meanwhile anyone following the README today registers 11 phantom types and 8 real types not at all.
3. **AI-agent error-resistance** — registry keys that are real registration keys, and docs that are executable truth, are structurally harder to misuse; a protocol export that lies about its own vocabulary is exactly the trap an agent-authored host falls into.
4. **Startup scope discipline** — A is a small alignment, not new surface; keeping the wrong keys is declare-and-maintain on a falsehood.

Boundary test: accept-set is not widened — this pulls a declared manual-integration contract back to enforced truth (the same reason the map's 4 siblings have these keys). Not on the human floor: no spec/protocol surface, no data migration, no published-capability removal; plugin-package export with measured zero consumers. No prior ruling narrowed or reversed.

**Binding conditions on the implementing PR**: (a) re-run the zero-consumer grep at claim time — if any consumer of `dashboardComponents` has appeared, STOP and escalate instead of breaking it; (b) changeset marks the re-key as breaking for the package; (c) update `README.md:42-52` in the same PR so map and docs flip together; (d) ⛔ do not add new exports or new types — 11 keys become 8 real ones, nothing else (per the #5002-family boundary). Rollback clause: if implementation surfaces a real external consumer or any contract question, the card returns to `needs-user-decision` — never re-adjudicate silently.

Maintainer veto window: this round's report (auto-adjudication list). Size/model suggestion: S / sonnet–opus.

**PM 分层处置**(objectui 分片 PM,session `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`,2026-08-17 23:26Z):

1. **map 键收敛题(A vs B)→ `needs-user-decision` 入决策箱**。理由:A(键改 schema type,与四个兄弟包收敛)方向上契约先行、卡面倾向成立,但 `dashboardComponents` 是已发布的公开导出 —— 外部消费者可能按 `dashboardComponents.DashboardRenderer` **具名取值**,改键对这类用法是 semver-major;而本仓 `check-changeset-no-major` 门禁当前禁 major。发布口径与 breaking 判定超出 PM 代裁面,交维护者(若裁 A,README 再跟一步的成本极小)。
2. **README 文档半(:42-52 教错的手动注册循环)不等裁定,按 B 形先修** —— 它今天就在教读者注册 11 个幻影 type + 触发 11 条弃用告警;删循环、教副作用导入 + 8 个真 type 表(#5002 家族减法形),与 A/B 裁定不冲突。该半与 #5066 同文件合单派发,PR 将以 `Part of #5064` 关联、**不关本卡** —— 本卡留给 map 键裁定。

**Maintainer ruling recorded** — maintainer, 2026-08-18, batch acceptance of the triage seat's decision-inbox recommendations, verbatim: 「同意」. Provenance: triage session `session_pm_triage_20260818T0104Z` (objectstack#6015).

**Ruled: Route A — re-key `dashboardComponents` to the 8 real schema types, and the maintainer authorizes a one-PR exception to the `check-changeset-no-major` policy for this re-key** (rationale on record: two independent word-boundary greps measured zero consumers, so the breaking set is empty today and only grows; a breaking changeset is the honest label). The 2026-08-17 auto-adjudication's four binding conditions stand unchanged: (a) re-run the zero-consumer grep at claim time — any consumer found ⇒ STOP and escalate; (b) changeset marks the re-key as breaking; (c) README's map-key statements flip in the same PR (the truth-table half already landed via PR #5093 stays); (d) ⛔ no new exports or types — 11 keys become 8 real ones, nothing else.

Label `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke.

Container & model: `S`–`M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: claude-fable-5`. Triage suggested `sonnet`–`opus`; I took it above both. Reason stated rather than assumed: this re-keys a **published export** and lands a **breaking** changeset under a maintainer-authorised one-PR policy exception. Tier from `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:1569`), read this round.
Clause-②: yes — content limb. Re-keying a published export changes the shape of a public surface; dispatched **at** the contract-review tier, so no `needs:contract-review` is owed at enqueue.
Serial constraints cleared: `packages/plugin-dashboard` is free — no open PR touches it (PR #5093, the README truth-table half, **already merged**), and it is disjoint from all four other in-flight cards this round.

## Zone 1 — Maintainer ruling, ⛔ not re-litigable

Maintainer, 2026-08-18, verbatim 「同意」: **Route A** — re-key `dashboardComponents` to the 8 real schema types, plus an explicit **one-PR exception to `check-changeset-no-major`** for this re-key. The four binding conditions from the 2026-08-17 auto-adjudication stand unchanged: (a) re-run the zero-consumer grep at claim time; (b) changeset marks it breaking; (c) README's map-key statements flip in the same PR; (d) ⛔ no new exports or types — 11 keys become 8 real ones, nothing else.

Rollback clause, still live: a real external consumer or any contract question ⇒ **stop**, card returns to `needs-user-decision`. ⛔ Never re-adjudicate silently.

## Condition (a) — I ran it, and it holds. Run it again anyway.

On `origin/main` this round, word-boundary `dashboardComponents` across `packages apps examples content docs e2e` returns **exactly three hits, none of them a consumer**:

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:338` — the definition
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md:85` — prose about the export
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx:117` — the same prose, duplicated

Counter-probed with `kanbanComponents`, which returns its definition *and* its README registration loop — so the pattern finds consumers when they exist, and this zero is a real zero. **Re-run it at your claim anyway**: it is a binding condition, and my reading is minutes old, not authoritative at your commit.

## ⚠️ The trap this card now has that the ruling predates

PR #5093 already landed the README truth-table half, so **both doc sites now carry *measured factual statements* about these keys** ("two measured facts about it"). Your re-key **falsifies those statements**. Condition (c) covers the README. The `content/docs` copy is filed separately as #5094 — but #5094 is about the *duplication*, and it does not license this PR to leave behind a sentence it personally made false.

**So**: read both sentences. Update the one in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` **if and only if** the re-key makes it untrue, keep the edit to that sentence, and say so explicitly in the PR body. If it turns out to be phrased so it stays true, leave it and say that instead. Do not expand into #5094's scope either way. A PR that ships a doc statement it knowingly falsified is the exact failure this card is about.

## Zone 2 — measured context (verify, don't trust)

The card's own quantified point, worth keeping in view: this deviation is **invisible to every gate**. The export-name check is green because `dashboardComponents` really is exported, and the old README loop compiled under strict mode because the phantom keys are runtime strings into a `register(type: string, …)`. Nothing static will tell you if you get the key vocabulary wrong — the 8 real types must be read off the `ComponentRegistry.register` call sites themselves (card cites `dashboard`:44, `metric`:65, `metric-card`:80, `object-metric`:151, `pivot`:185, `object-pivot`:260, `dashboard-grid`:296, `object-data-table`:316 — **take them from the tree, the line numbers are from 2026-08-17**).

## Gates

Derive from your diff — expect `Lint`, `Type Check`, the test shards, and the changeset family. **The changeset gate is the interesting one here**: the repo's `check-changeset-no-major` normally forbids `major`, and the maintainer has authorised a one-PR exception for exactly this re-key. If the gate blocks you, that is the expected collision, not a reason to downgrade the changeset to `patch` to get green — quote the maintainer's authorisation in the PR body and report if it still blocks. ⛔ Do not weaken a gate to pass.

## Deliver

Draft PR against `main`, first line `Fixes #5064`. Push the branch early. Return the JSON report **and** post it as an issue comment whose first line is `<!-- os-dev-report -->`. Read the full issue body and every comment on GitHub yourself — the ruling chain here is four comments long and the disposition **changed** partway through — and check the body for sanitizer truncation before relying on it.

**Status check from the PM seat** (session `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`) — no action requested, recording where this card actually stands so it is not read as in-flight work.

**Implementation is done.** PR #5207 (`Fixes #5064`) has been up since 2026-08-18 14:34Z: Route A implemented, 5 files, the pin test added, condition (a)'s zero-consumer grep re-run at claim and counter-probed with `kanbanComponents`. Conditions (a)–(d) all met.

**It is parked, deliberately, on #5208** — the decision card I filed at 14:36Z on discovering that the authorized one-PR `major` exception moves **all 39 packages** a major, because they share one changeset `fixed` group. The exception was granted against a measured blast radius of *zero consumers*; the accounting's blast radius is the whole fleet plus the `@objectstack` same-major-⇒-compatible convention. Only the first number was on the table when the exception was granted.

So the two red limbs on PR #5207 (`Changeset Bump Policy`, and the repo-state assertion in `scripts/__tests__/check-changeset-no-major.test.ts`) are **the authorized exception, not defects**. Restating the commitment I made on #5208: ⛔ I will not clear either gate by any route — not by downgrading the changeset, not by touching the test — and **PR #5207 stays draft and unqueued until #5208 is answered.** A seat clearing its own red gate by relabelling is indistinguishable from the failure mode the no-major gate exists to defeat.

**Why this card keeps `pm:dispatched` rather than moving to `pm:blocked`**: I considered the swap and rejected it. `pm:blocked` is only legitimate with a machine-greppable `Blocked-by:` line in the **body**, and rewriting this body through the API would double-escape the HTML entities the read returns (`'` inside the code blocks), corrupting a carefully measured card to buy a label. `pm:dispatched` + an open PR + a filed decision card is already an honest, complete state — the same state #4266 held while its PR was open. The named reader for the parked status is #5208 itself and the seat post (objectstack#6025), where it is now recorded.

**No re-dispatch.** Anyone reading this card as available work should not pick it up — the code exists on `claude/issue-5064-dashboard-components-rekey`.
